explainer.title: The Permanent Difference
explainer.paragraph1: Electrolysis works by sending a slight electrical current through a fine probe inserted into each hair follicle. This destroys the follicle's ability to produce hair permanently. Once destroyed, that follicle will never regrow hair.
explainer.paragraph2: This is why electrolysis is the only scientifically proven permanent hair removal method. While other methods may reduce hair, only electrolysis offers true permanence.

hairGrowthPhases.title: Understanding Hair Growth Cycles
hairGrowthPhases.description: Hair doesn't grow continuously. Understanding these three phases explains why permanent removal requires multiple sessions.
hairGrowthPhases.treatableNote: Only treatment during Anagen results in permanent hair removal.

phases.name: Anagen
phases.subtitle: Growth Phase
phases.description: Hair actively grows from the follicle. This is the only phase when electrolysis can permanently destroy the follicle.

phases.name: Catagen
phases.subtitle: Transition Phase
phases.description: Hair transitions from growth to rest. The follicle begins to separate from the root.

phases.name: Telogen
phases.subtitle: Resting Phase
phases.description: Hair rests in the follicle before shedding. The follicle is dormant and cannot be treated effectively.

multiple.title: Why Multiple Sessions Are Needed
multiple.paragraph1: At any given time, only about 85% of hair is in the Anagen growth phase. The remaining 10-15% is resting and cannot be treated. This means your first appointment treats the actively growing hairs.
multiple.paragraph2: Over the next several weeks, new hairs from other phases will enter Anagen and become visible. These are treated in follow-up sessions until all hairs have been permanently removed. This typically takes 6-12 months.

faq.description: Answers to common questions about the treatment, results, and permanent removal.

items.question: Is electrolysis really permanent?
items.answer: Yes. Electrolysis is the only scientifically proven permanent method of hair removal. Once the hair follicle is destroyed, it cannot produce hair again. Results are permanent.

items.question: How long does a session take?
items.answer: Time varies based on the area. Small areas like the upper lip may take 15-30 minutes, while larger areas can take 1-2 hours. I will provide a timeline at our consultation.

items.question: How many sessions will I need?
items.answer: Most clients need 6-12 sessions over several months. This is because only hair in the active growth phase can be treated permanently.

items.question: Does it hurt?
items.answer: Electrolysis causes minimal discomfort, often described as a slight tingling. I prioritize your comfort throughout the session.

items.question: Will there be redness after treatment?
items.answer: Most clients experience minimal redness that fades within hours. I apply soothing products immediately after treatment.

items.question: Does it work on all hair colors?
items.answer: Yes. Electrolysis works on all skin types and all hair colors, including blonde, red, gray, and white. It is the most inclusive method available.
